title: identity step 1, addendum 1
written: 2026-11-17, after exploring settings on dev windows only (117092 1st f024810 / f018910 / 2nd f025846, 117093 1st f061613, 118575 1st f031986, 118577 1st f028291), before any test-match run
why: the plan's continuity counts all frames, so it is capped by detection coverage (a player is matched to our detections on ~63-70% of frames): its 0.80 target is out of reach even with a perfect identity
the alpha-beta velocity (beta 0.2) is unstable on our jittery positions (frame-to-frame step median 0.31 m, p90 1.5 m at stride 2); beta 0.05 and a larger gate helped continuity on dev

117092: our positions do not meet the truth (U continuity 0.045 vs 0.29-0.37 elsewhere in player_stitch), a matching or calibration issue, not identity: excluded from selection and from the test summaries (reported apart)

changes.new measure (primary): identity share = a player's matched samples on his main trajectory / all his matched samples (main = the trajectory matched to him most); continuity kept and reported
changes.choice on dev: the cell with the highest (identity share median - mixing median), arm T
changes.step target (test matches, 3 m): identity share median >= 0.80 with mixing median <= 0.05, best of T and T+S

unchanged: everything else in plan.json; test matches untouched so far
